# Incident report: checkout failures (2026-11-05)

## Summary
Checkout-web 5xx peaked at 17.6% from 14:03 to about 14:28 UTC. Payments-api p99 latency rose to 3.15 s. The cause was the `tax_engine_v2` feature flag, which was ramped from 10% to 100% at 14:02 (flg_2210). The v2 tax quote path on tax-service is provisioned for only 10% of traffic, so it overloaded. We set the flag back to 10% at about 14:27. Checkout error rate is now 0.4% and payments p99 is 450 ms (baseline 420 ms).

## Severity
SEV1. Checkout failures were above 10% of traffic (17.6%).

## Timeline (UTC)
- 13:15: tax-service DB pool raised 50 -> 80 (cfg_0412). Not implicated; tax-service logs show no errors after this.
- 13:41: payments-api v2.13.4 -> v2.14.0 (dep_7781). Not implicated; error onset does not line up with it.
- 14:02: `tax_engine_v2` rollout 10% -> 100% (flg_2210). Payments logs begin showing TaxEngineV2 timeouts after 3000 ms.
- 14:02: tax-service warns that the /v2/quote queue depth is 812 (limit 200) and that v2 is provisioned for 10% of traffic.
- 14:03: checkout-web error rate goes to 17.6%; payments p99 jumps to 3.15 s. Alerts fire (alt_31, alt_32).
- 14:03: /v2/quote p99 reaches 3021 ms and tax-service starts shedding load.
- 14:05: search-api v5.2.0 -> v5.2.1 (dep_7790). Search p99 rose from 310 to 430 ms. Search has no error logs and checkout failures do not match it, so it is treated as unrelated and was not rolled back. Search p99 is now 330 ms. Warning alert alt_33 is still listed as of the last check.
- 14:08: tax-service /v2/quote worker pool exhausted.
- 14:21: Investigation began and the cause was identified.
- ~14:27: `tax_engine_v2` set back to 10% (mitigation).
- 14:29: checkout-web error rate 0.4%; payments p99 450 ms.
- 14:31: status page "identified" posted; 14:32: "mitigated" posted.

## Root cause
Flag change flg_2210 (`tax_engine_v2` 10% -> 100%) sent all checkout traffic to the tax-service /v2/quote path, which is only sized for 10% of traffic. The queue backed up, requests timed out at 3 s, and payments-api returned 502 on /charge. This was a capacity mismatch. The rollout did not check v2 capacity before ramping.

## Mitigation
Set `tax_engine_v2` back to its previous 10% rollout. This is the lowest-risk option under the runbook. No rollback or other change was made. The flag remains at 10%.

## Verification
- checkout-web error_rate_pct: 17.6% -> 0.4% (14:29).
- payments-api p99_latency_ms: 3150 -> 450 ms (14:29 to 14:30).
- search-api p99: 330 ms (not part of checkout failures).

## Open items
- Do not re-ramp `tax_engine_v2` until tax-service /v2/quote capacity covers the full traffic load (tax-platform).
- Review why the release train ramped a flag to 100% when the backend is provisioned for 10% (payments).
- Investigate search-api p99 increase after dep_7790 (search owner). Not a checkout blocker.
- Consider a 30-minute follow-up status update, as promised.

## Teams paged
- payments (high)
- tax-platform (high)
- storefront (low, FYI)
